item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. From delivering services to managing infrastructure, it will give public institutions greater capacity to get things done.

2. We see a future in which every government can solve problems faster and deliver services better. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make that future possible—and make every government more effective.

3. We stand for more effective government. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will strengthen every government’s ability to plan, coordinate and deliver. We must prepare public institutions to put that capability to work.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We see this as a transformation in public capacity: better planning, faster administration, stronger coordination and more reliable delivery of essential services. Governments everywhere face complex problems, and superintelligent AI will expand their ability to understand those problems and act on them. We must prepare now by strengthening public institutions, building technical expertise and establishing clear accountability for how these systems are used. Our task is to turn greater capability into better government, and we are committed to making that transformation serve the public.
